disturbances.cbm_description: Same as the default Clearcut harvesting disturbance type, except all snags are transferred to the Medium pool

This disturbance type can be used to simulate a 40% reduction in biomass carbon and a transfer of the merchantable C to the forest product sector (FPS).  The remaining carbon removed from the biomass pools is transferred to the respective DOM pools.
disturbances.notes: Proxy for 40% basal-area removal from below; CBM 40% commercial thinning removes 40% biomass carbon, so this is an upper bound on merchantable-volume removal. Replace with a custom matrix when cruise/intensity data are available.
Sylva 85% precommercial thinning; merchantable volume is near zero at the usual age 10-20, so the stock effect is small.
Evergreen placeholder: 10% softwood mortality depends on pine fraction and beetle intensity; use a severity-specific type when the instance supplies one.

disturbances.cbm_description: Salvage logging on areas burned by fire.
disturbances.notes: Use only when the salvage type is known; usually paired with a preceding fire event.
